stories.title: Cooper Flagg's 43-Point Masterpiece Lifts Mavericks Past Pacers 125-122

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Down 10 at half. Cooper Flagg didn't care.

43 points. 10 rebounds. 6 assists. 3 steals.

Mavericks 125, Pacers 122. The comeback was all Flagg.

#Mavericks #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Cooper Flagg: 43 pts, 10 reb, 6 ast on Monday night.

He is now the 2nd teenager in NBA history with 40+ points, 10+ rebounds and 5+ assists in a game.

No. 1? Look it up. It's rarefied company.

#Mavericks #NBA

stories.title: Warriors 138, Pelicans 87 — Golden State's 8-Game Win Streak Reaches New Heights

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Warriors 138, Pelicans 87.

Golden State won by 51 points. Eight straight wins. Steph Curry moved into 16th on the all-time scoring list.

This team is locked in. #Warriors #DubNation #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Stephen Curry: 25 points in 21 minutes. 4-of-7 from three. 9-of-9 at the line.

21 team threes. 37 assists.

The Warriors aren't just winning. They're imposing their will. 138-87.

#Warriors #NBA
